text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Well, now that I'm done studying,
maybe I'll just check my emails and head to sleep.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Twenty new notifications, huh... If I reply to all of them,
I'll probably end up going to sleep late, but—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
No, if it's from a company in a vastly different time zone,
it's better to reply while it's still daytime there.
Let's check it out first!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
For real!? Seven new messages!?
And I haven't even finished replying to the old ones...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, there'll be no end to this if I try to handle the additional requests too.
I'm terribly sorry, but let's push some of this off until tomorrow...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having halted her work midway through, Satono Crown ended up carrying that unsettled feeling into the next day.
